name: 黃翔龍
objective:
表現法課程主要目的在訓練學生建築設計手繪之能力，起始為建築素描點線、面，體的基礎訓練，進而了解基本設計之理論，進而訓練建築手繪之草圖設計訓練，基本之建築平面、立面，剖面及透視圖之實作繪製，從而培養學生手繪設計之能力，及因應建築師考試快速設計之訓練，也配合未來 AI 之運用達到手繪與電繪之結合，此為本課程之訓練主要目標。
"The objective of this architectural presentation drawing course is rooted in architectural design sketching and the fundamental design theories of point, line, plane, and mass. Through rigorous training in these sketching techniques, the second stage focuses on the mastery of architectural plans, elevations, sections, and perspective drawings.
Furthermore, the curriculum is specifically designed to align with the Rapid Design requirements of the Architectural Licensing Examination. To meet future marketing demands, the integration of AI applications is also a key learning objective of this course."
